name: web-recipe
description: External web-recipe STORE + PROVIDER: a durable per-domain recipe (read path, named selectors, discovered JSON endpoints, login flow by credential NAME, quirks, provenance) in one human-readable file per domain, exposed as the tools 'recipe get', 'recipe save', 'recipe list', 'recipe delete', 'recipe verify' and as the cordis service `web-recipe` (contract web-recipe@1) that web-page consumes for its read-through

dir.description: where the recipes live, one JSON file per domain (default: <tmp>/workbench-web-recipe; the dev config points it at .workbench/web-recipe, which is git-ignored)

minConfidence.description: a recipe below this confidence is not offered to the read-through

maxAgeDays.description: when > 0, a recipe whose lastVerifiedAt is older than this many days is ignored (0 = no age limit)

demoteOnFailure.description: a failed verification lowers confidence (and after enough failures the recipe falls below minConfidence and stops being used)

demoteStep.description: how much one verification moves confidence

acceptRecords.description: may a CONSUMER record a discovered read path at all (a discovery never overwrites an existing recipe)

recordConfidence.description: confidence a freshly recorded, never verified recipe starts with

verifyTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout of a `recipe verify` API probe
